prayers.title: Shema Yisrael
lines: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְהוָה אֶחָד׃
prayers.english: HEAR, O ISRAEL: THE LORD OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE.
prayers.attribution: Hebrew text: Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC) UXLC 2.6 (file dated 19 Oct 2026), Tanach.us Inc., West Redding, CT, USA (tanach.us; "may be viewed or copied without restriction"). Cantillation marks removed. Not the WLC. English: JPS 1917, public domain.

prayers.title: Baruch shem (said after Shema line)
lines: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
prayers.english: Blessed is the name of the glory of his kingship for ever and ever.
prayers.attribution: Hebrew text: Torat Emet 357 (toratemetfreeware.com), as digitised on Sefaria where it is labelled Public Domain. Label not independently verified; the toratemetfreeware.com home page carries an all-rights-reserved footer (read 2026-11-04). English: original literal gloss.

prayers.title: HaMotzi (blessing over bread)
lines: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם הַמּוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן הָאָרֶץ׃
prayers.english: Blessed are you, LORD our God, king of the world, who brings forth bread from the earth.

prayers.title: Blessing over wine
lines: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגָּפֶן׃
prayers.english: Blessed are you, LORD our God, king of the world, who creates the fruit of the vine.
prayers.attribution: Hebrew text: Torat Emet 357 (toratemetfreeware.com), as digitised on Sefaria where it is labelled Public Domain. Label not independently verified. English: original literal gloss.

prayers.title: Shabbat candle blessing
lines: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ לְהַדְלִיק נֵר שֶׁל שַׁבָּת׃
prayers.english: Blessed are you, LORD our God, king of the world, who made us holy with his commandments and commanded us to light the lamp of Shabbat.
prayers.attribution: Hebrew text: Torat Emet 357 (toratemetfreeware.com), as digitised on Sefaria where it is labelled Public Domain. Label not independently verified. English: original literal gloss.
prayers.source: Torat Emet 357 via Sefaria: Siddur Sefard, Shabbat Candle Lighting

prayers.title: Modeh Ani (on waking)
lines: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
prayers.english: I give thanks before you, living and enduring king, that you have returned my soul to me in mercy; great is your faithfulness.

prayers.title: Barchu (call to the Torah blessing)
prayers.ref: Siddur: Barchu before the Torah reading
prayers.english:
Bless the LORD, the blessed one.
Blessed is the LORD, the blessed one, for ever and ever.
prayers.attribution: Hebrew text: Siddur Edot HaMizrach, "Shaliehsaboo Edition", from Sefaria where it is labelled CC0 (no attribution required; credit given as a courtesy). Label not independently verified. English: original literal gloss.

prayers.title: Oseh shalom (end of the Amidah and of Kaddish)
lines: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן׃
prayers.english: He who makes peace in his high places, may he make peace for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

prayers.title: Shehecheyanu (first-time and festival blessing)
lines: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם שֶׁהֶחֱיָינוּ וְקִיְּמָנוּ וְהִגִּיעָנוּ לַזְּמַן הַזֶּה׃
prayers.english: Blessed are you, LORD our God, king of the world, who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this time.
